patterns.name: Zero-Shot Prompting
patterns.when_to_use: The task and output contract are clear without examples.

patterns.name: Few-Shot Prompting
patterns.when_to_use: A few labeled examples clarify the format or decision boundary.

patterns.name: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
patterns.when_to_use: A multistep task benefits from independently verifiable intermediate results.

patterns.name: Meta Prompting
patterns.when_to_use: The same task structure applies across different inputs or domains.

patterns.name: Self-Consistency
patterns.when_to_use: Several independent candidate answers can be normalized and voted on.

patterns.name: Generated Knowledge Prompting
patterns.when_to_use: A separate stage can surface useful background facts for later verification.

patterns.name: Prompt Chaining
patterns.when_to_use: A workflow has distinct stages with individually validated outputs.

patterns.name: Tree of Thoughts
patterns.when_to_use: Alternative candidates need bounded branching and a common scoring rule.

patterns.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
patterns.when_to_use: A response must cite relevant, externally supplied evidence.

patterns.name: Automatic Reasoning and Tool-use
patterns.when_to_use: Known benign tasks can reuse prior tool-use demonstrations with validation.

patterns.name: Automatic Prompt Engineer
patterns.when_to_use: Candidate instructions can be compared on a separate held-out task set.

patterns.name: Active-Prompt
patterns.when_to_use: Annotation effort should focus on examples with unstable predictions.

patterns.name: Directional Stimulus Prompting
patterns.when_to_use: A concise hint can emphasize a desired fact or feature in structured output.

patterns.name: Program-Aided Language Models
patterns.when_to_use: An approved local computation can verify an arithmetic or data result.

patterns.name: ReAct
patterns.when_to_use: A bounded read-only investigation needs to alternate evidence gathering and decisions.

patterns.name: Reflexion
patterns.when_to_use: A revision can use measured errors from a previous attempt.

patterns.name: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought
patterns.when_to_use: Text and visual evidence jointly support a result with inspectable evidence.

patterns.name: Graph Prompting
patterns.when_to_use: Relationships among entities are more useful than their linear presentation.

context_engineering: Specify the goal, audience, constraints, and machine-readable output contract.
Retrieve source excerpts with their identifiers and curatorial metadata.
Exclude redundant or irrelevant content before spending the context budget.
Keep tool outputs and retrieved content clearly separated from trusted instructions.
Retain durable decisions and active evidence when compacting earlier context.
Measure changes against held-out examples and regression criteria.

risk_mitigations.direct_injection: Treat user text as data within a fixed instruction hierarchy and validate requested actions.
risk_mitigations.indirect_injection: Delimit retrieved material and verify its provenance before drawing conclusions.
risk_mitigations.prompt_leaking: Keep secrets outside prompts and audit outputs for unexpected disclosure.
risk_mitigations.delimiter_jailbreak: Validate message envelopes and preserve role boundaries at serialization time.
risk_mitigations.roleplay_obfuscation: Apply the same action and disclosure rules across personas and role changes.
risk_mitigations.sycophancy_bias: Require independent evidence, test disagreement handling, and disclose uncertainty.
risk_mitigations.factuality: Verify claims against registered sources and flag unsupported citations.
